packageRules.description: MusicBee plugins must run on .NET Framework 4.8 (net48). Major bumps risk dropping net48/netstandard2.0 support (e.g. MQTTnet 5.x on Musicbee-MQTT) — evaluate each major manually against net48 before enabling it.

IL weavers run inside the net48 build and Costura embeds the output into mb_SendSpin.dll. A weaver update can break the build or the embedded-dll layout silently — update these manually and rebuild the full plugin.
Noise protocol stack (Noise.NET + native libsodium) implements the Sendspin pairing/handshake. Majors must be verified manually against the pairing flow and the wire-format tests.
mDNS discovery for the Music Assistant server. 0.x package written against the 0.27.0 API; newer versions change the API and may drop net48-usable assets.
